title: NayaPOWER Current Architectural Truth — One Organism, One Brain, Many Doors

source.source_reference: Human Director requested that the current NayaPOWER architectural analysis be locked into the Brain as durable intelligence, linked to Team Naya coordination in GitHub Issue #554, and made retrievable by future Nayas.

intelligence.essence: NayaPOWER has moved beyond an architecture sketch. The major organs, contracts, governance, intelligence model, graph model, Value Calculus, nine-node genome, design intelligence and persistence machinery exist in substantial form. The limiting frontier is now composition: making the organs operate together under exact runtime/source parity, proving causal behavior in production, making learning measurably improve future behavior, proving cold succession, and projecting the same canonical intelligence honestly through the Hub. The governing engineering strategy is therefore convergence plus proof, not endless parallel architecture.

human_view.what_we_have_built: NayaPOWER is the governed intelligence and memory substrate; NayaNET is the network of interfaces; the Hub is the human-facing visual projection. The architecture follows one brain, one tree, many doors.
human_view.what_is_strong: The system has a defined North Star, constitutional governance, explicit epistemic states, provenance rules, a nine-node model, an Intelligent Block memory unit, an intelligent graph, Decision Value Calculus V2.1, design intelligence doctrine, completion doctrine and machine-visible proof boundaries.
human_view.what_is_not_finished: The current main branch still does not establish universal live runtime binding/influence or full production parity. The live Graph V2 and live Value receipt path remain proof boundaries. Learning and evolution still need measured causal improvement. Cold successor continuity remains incomplete. The Hub implementation exists on an active candidate branch but is not yet the current-main production-proven whole application.
human_view.simple_rule: Stop adding architecture unless it closes a named proof gap. Converge the best existing work onto current main, execute the smallest safe integration slice, and verify the whole causal chain.

simple_view.child: We have built most of the spaceship parts. Now we have to connect them, turn them on, fly the whole ship, test every control, remember what we learned, and prove the next captain can fly it without being retaught everything.
simple_view.grandma: The pieces are mostly here. The important work now is making sure they truly work together, checking the real thing rather than the plans, keeping the good lessons, and making the next person able to continue without starting over.

naya_view.purpose: Turn a collection of individually strong organs into one continuously operating, evidence-bearing intelligence organism.
naya_view.architecture_law: ONE BRAIN / ONE TREE / MANY DOORS. NayaPOWER is the substrate. NayaNET is the network. The Hub is projection, not source-of-truth.
naya_view.organism_flow: SELF → LAW → ACT → KNOW → PROVE → CONNECT → VERIFY → LEARN → EVOLVE → SELF
naya_view.proof_frontier: The remaining qualification frontier is not primarily semantic design. It is runtime parity, real generalized node influence, durable persistence, causal behavior change, independent verification, measurable learning, successor continuity, human-value measurement and disciplined convergence.
naya_view.convergence_rule: Parallel intelligence is useful only when it converges. Overlapping branches, duplicated design laws, stale projections and conflicting drafts must be reconciled against the exact current main truth before promotion.
naya_view.completion_rule: A shell, score, document, source implementation or isolated successful test is not equivalent to a complete living system. Whole-system claims require whole-system evidence.

intelligence.applicability: Use for Naya continuation, architecture decisions, branch convergence, Hub completion, design intelligence, runtime proof planning, handoffs and future successor reconstruction.
intelligence.learning_lesson: The system has crossed the architecture-to-composition boundary. The highest-value intelligence now is disciplined convergence plus evidence: connect the existing organs, prove their causal operation, measure learning, prove succession, and expose the same canonical intelligence through the Hub without creating a second brain.
intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor should restore current main truth, read this note before proposing new architecture, locate the strongest existing implementation, reconcile overlapping work, choose one proof-bearing frontier, execute the smallest safe change, independently verify it, and update this state only when evidence changes the frontier.
